name: skills
title_zh: 让 Agent 学会 Cloudflare 官方基建
tagline_zh: 不是文档堆砌，是官方手把手教 Agent 走通 Workers、Pages、KV 等真实基建流程。
tagline_en: Not docs soup—official step-by-step skills that teach agents real Cloudflare workflows. Fewer config mistakes.
desc_en: Skills for teaching agents how to build on Cloudflare.
why_zh: 每个 skill 都由 Cloudflare 官方维护，直接对齐当前 API 与最佳实践。
why_en: Maintained by Cloudflare itself, each skill tracks live APIs and best practices—so agents learn what actually works today, not.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Cloudflare 官方基建技能，不含第三方服务集成。
limit_en: Covers only Cloudflare's own infrastructure skills, no third-party integrations. Requires basic CLI/HTTP knowledge; some skills need a real account.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Official Cloudflare skill set for teaching agents
